plugins.name: vstack
plugins.description: Visual Stack is interactive wireframing for Claude Code. Build a screen from a prompt, screenshot, reference site, or design system, then comment directly on the result and receive each revision in the same browser workspace. It can also review a running app or public website route by route. Wireframes are self-contained HTML; local review state stays in the project.
